items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury; downgraded Saturday after limited/doubtful path.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; look to Ravens pass-catchers for volume bump.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes previously to Flowers shift to remaining WRs/TEs like Andrews or Lane.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots due to foot injury.
items.implication: Sit Pittman; boost PIT WR2/3 options like Metcalf or others.
items.opportunity: Pittman targets shift within Steelers passing game.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Sunday vs Bengals.
items.why: Hamstring strain from Wednesday practice; missed remaining practices.
items.implication: Sit Collins; elevate HOU TE/WR options in thin rooms.
items.opportunity: Collins' 10 targets open for Schultz (already high volume), Boutte, Hutchinson, Noel.

items.text: ETR The Rundown for Week 2 is live: game-by-game review of content including status, projections, cheap WR volume notes.
items.why: Comprehensive Sunday prep board with live updates.
items.implication: Check for final projections/status before lock.
items.opportunity: Focus on volume plays and injury beneficiaries.

items.text: Rams listed WR Puka Nacua questionable for MNF vs Giants (hip/groin soreness); Whittington doubtful (quad). McVay: pre-game decision, not related to camp psoas.
items.why: Groin soreness after Thursday practice; DNP Fri/Sat; different from camp injury.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; if out, TE-heavy (Ferguson/Parkinson) + secondary WRs.
items.opportunity: If inactive, routes to Adams + elevated/backup WRs; if active full role expected.

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (but expected to play) vs Texans.
items.why: Back issue; full practice progression, coach indicates good to go; elevated backup as precaution.
items.implication: Start Burrow confidently; monitor inactives ~90 min pre-kick.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes expected if active; no major role change.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday; elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White from PS.
items.why: Knee (post-meniscus procedure); limited Friday, test pregame but unlikely.
items.implication: Plan without Bowers; Michael Mayer or Myarick for TE volume.
items.opportunity: Bowers routes/targets to Mayer and elevated options vs Chargers.

items.text: If Puka misses MNF, expect heavier TE usage (Ferguson & Parkinson); biggest WR bump to Konata Mumpfield (or Malachi Fields) if Whittington also out. Have pivot ready.
items.why: Nacua Q + Whittington doubtful creates clear hierarchy shift.
items.implication: Prepare MNF replacements; TE stream viable.
items.opportunity: TE routes/targets + secondary WR snaps expand.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (rib) questionable; limited Friday after DNPs. ETR notes QJ and Tre Harris project 5+ targets regardless, large roles if out vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; limited return Friday.
items.implication: Monitor actives; if out, strong upgrade for Johnston/Harris cheap volume.
items.opportunity: McConkey high route/target share; QJ/Harris inherited 22%+ shares post-exit W1.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 74% snap, 21/24 RB touches through 3Q W1, 40% route targets (tied lead); IND gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite W1 utilization + soft IND run matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; upside for RB1 overall finish.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score W1 (tied Bijan lead), 19% target share last 10 games, 25+ touches 3/4 recent.
items.why: Near-max utilization + passing-game role + favorable LAC defense.
items.implication: RB1/high-end RB2 lock with volume security.
items.opportunity: Touches + targets in positive script potential.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: W1 RB9 util, 26% target share, 100% RB RZ touches; CLE soft vs run (121 yds/4.8 YPC).
LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1; career 93 yds/18 PPG with Wentz; CHI soft vs WRs recently.
items.why: Volume with Wentz + historical production + matchup.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rushes W1, most points via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further; underdog script.
items.why: Reduced W1 workload + Kamara return creates 3-headed committee risk.
items.implication: Fade/sit; prefer other RBs; Kamara cautious depth.

items.text: HATE Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: Only 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks; SEA tough vs WRs.
HATE Brian Thomas Jr. @ DEN: DEN elite vs perimeter/deep; limited practice shoulder; tough completion rate.
items.implication: Sit in favor of safer WRs.

items.text: LOVE Dak Prescott vs WAS: Home avg 21.3 PPG last yr; WAS torched W1 (14.5 YPC/3 TDs); top-5 implied total in high-total game.
items.why: Smash spot vs weak secondary + game script.

items.text: LOVE Dalton Kincaid vs DET: Top-5 TE util W1, 69% route rate (career high season); DET allowed 27 Fpts to TEs W1.
